summary: The change replaces the low-contrast primary colors in both schemes with #0066cc and #005bb5, which exceed 4.5:1 against the white primary foreground. The primary button rule consumes those variables directly, and the blue identity is retained.

evidence: public/styles.css lines 12-13 set light --primary to #0066cc and --primary-hover to #005bb5; against #ffffff these give approximately 5.57:1 and 6.63:1, both above 4.5:1.
public/styles.css lines 61-62 apply the same values in the dark scheme, fixing the previously lighter dark --primary-hover value.
The #login rule at lines 348-356 uses --primary and --primary-hover with --primary-foreground, so the primary button inherits the corrected contrast in both schemes.
The blue identity survives through the corrected values and the unchanged --accent color; no remaining hardcoded primary button background was found.
